versions.changelog:
Initial release — free API for tracking UN Sustainable Development Goals using World Bank data.

- Provides progress monitoring by country, region, or globally across 17 SDGs and 232 indicators.
- No subscription required; pay-per-use with USDC micropayments.
- Supports queries by country code, SDG numbers, indicators, and year range.
- Use cases include SDG alignment reporting, program monitoring, and sustainability scoring.
